cluster.root_problem: The retry loop has no upper bound

summary.mechanism: Adds an attempt counter to the retry loop

reviewer.label: Reviewer
reviewer.reason: The counter resets inside the loop, so retries remain unbounded

findings.headline: Counter resets
findings.why: The increment never reaches the limit

input.title: Deduplicate queue entries
input.diff:
diff --git a/src/queue.ts b/src/queue.ts
--- a/src/queue.ts
+++ b/src/queue.ts
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 export const items: string[] = []
-export function enqueue(id: string) { items.push(id) }
+export function enqueue(id: string) {
+  if (!items.includes(id)) items.push(id)
+}
diff --git a/src/queue.test.ts b/src/queue.test.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/queue.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+import { test, expect } from 'vitest'
+import { enqueue, items } from './queue'
+test('does not enqueue one id twice', () => {
+  enqueue('job-1')
+  enqueue('job-1')
+  expect(items).toEqual(['job-1'])
+})
